title: Registry on the clinical course of ocular inflammation
summary: Uveitis can have a highly variable course, with significant differences in symptoms and complications. The effectiveness of various treatment options can also vary considerably from person to person. Therefore, the aim of this study is to gain a better understanding of the disease progression of uveitis and to investigate complications and the effectiveness of therapies in more detail. This study will only collect information that is already gathered through routine examinations. This includes visual acuity, intraocular pressure, treatments (including their duration and effects), and any complications. Adult patients can voluntarily complete a quality-of-life questionnaire every three months. The responses will be digitally recorded and stored using the IMI-EDC (Institute for Medical Informatics – Electronic Data Capture) application, developed by the Institute for Medical Informatics at Heidelberg University.
conditions: Included are all patients with uveitis of all anatomical locations (anterior, intermedia, posterior uveitis as well as panuveitis), regardless of the etiology.

interventions.name: Prospective and retrospective analysis of all patients aged seven years and older who received a diagnosis of uveitis since 2006.
